transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Salieri! I’ve been away for two weeks on the Emperor’s business, trusting you to keep the rehearsals on schedule! The singers don’t know their entrances, the second violin parts are missing entirely, and someone has rewritten my stage directions without a word to me! The premiere is in ten days! You gave me your word that everything would be in order!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Ah, my dear colleague, it is with great regret that I must inform you of the unfortunate turn of events in your absence. I did indeed endeavor to maintain order in your stead, but it appears that unforeseen circumstances have led to a rather chaotic situation in our preparations for the premiere.

Rest assured, I share your concern regarding the state of disarray in which we find ourselves. It is imperative that we rectify these issues promptly to ensure a successful performance for His Imperial Majesty. Let us gather the singers and musicians together without delay to address the lack of preparedness and missing parts.

As for the unauthorized alterations to your stage directions, I understand your frustration at this breach of trust and artistic integrity. We shall discuss this matter with the appropriate parties and work towards reinstating your original vision for the opera.

Together, we shall strive to bring order back to our rehearsals and restore the harmony and precision necessary for a memorable premiere. Your dedication to your craft is commendable, and I am confident that we can overcome these challenges with diligence and collaboration.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"Unforeseen circumstances," Salieri? Unforeseen? I left you with a fully prepared score, a detailed rehearsal schedule, and explicit instructions! What "circumstances" could possibly lead to *missing parts* and *rewritten stage directions*? This isn't some minor oversight; this is chaos!

And "discuss this matter with the appropriate parties"? I want to know *who* dared to touch my work, and *why* you allowed it to happen! You were here! You were in charge! Ten days, Salieri! Ten days until we stand before the Emperor, and we're starting from scratch! Your "endeavor to maintain order" seems to have resulted in utter disarray!

transcript.text:

I take full responsibility for the missing parts and the unauthorized alterations to your stage directions. It was never my intention for such disruptions to occur, and I acknowledge the severity of the situation we find ourselves in.

As for the individuals who made these changes without your consent, I shall conduct a thorough investigation to identify those responsible. I assure you that such actions will not go unaddressed, and I will work diligently to ensure that all decisions regarding your work are made in collaboration and with the utmost respect for your creative vision.

I share your sense of urgency as we approach the premiere, and I am fully committed to working alongside you to restore order and bring our opera to the stage with the excellence it deserves. Please accept my sincerest apologies for the chaos that has ensued, and rest assured that I will spare no effort in rectifying the situation and upholding the standards of professionalism and artistry that our esteemed court demands.

transcript.text:
